title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
content: Skerritt was Captain Dallas in Alien, Viper in Top Gun, and a small town sheriff in the TV series Picket Fences.

title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
content: The judge found the department's field operations to identify noncitizens who voted likely violated the Voting Rights Act, which bars voter intimidation.

title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
content: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
content: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

title: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this
content: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
content: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
content: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
content: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
content: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
content: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.
